title: XR Motion and Communication Polish · v0.10.2
changes: Status notifications are now muted-green, slightly smaller, and fade in quickly/fade out slowly without typed characters or typing sounds.
XR status text inherits the same smoothed eye transform rather than drifting on a separate follow clock.
Hand-grabbed experimental frames preserve a fingertip contact offset and rotate with the tracked wrist orientation in full 3D.
Mascot flight banking and pitching follow travel direction, with a gently damped orientation and occasional subtle pirouette.
Mascot speech bubbles are larger, wrap readable text, and open/close with a restrained scale-and-opacity animation.
No backend changes, new spending limits or watcher changes.
